name: Mail hauberk
description: Thousands of riveted rings. Stops a blade; does not stop anyone hearing you coming.
notes: A mail body piece at ADR-0003's reference weight (8 kg): with the wooden shield, 11 kg is a Medium load for a knight (37% of 30 kg). Grey-box starting kit item (mw-e19.4); tuned with the final kits in m2/m3.
